column1: # Authored expectation for the Phase-3 test-surface join.
# Section S clause 2: the run enumerates its test surfaces and joins them completely to an
# independently authored expectation. The join is two-way and total, so a check that
# exists but is claimed by no surface fails the gate, and a surface naming an id nothing
# owner is the registry the ids are enumerated from at run time:
#   checks    the check ids tools/artifact_calculus_gate.py implements
# The three mutant loci are deliberately three different instruments — an in-process
# check, a two-process comparison, and a typecheck — so each has its own surface rather
# than one surface for "the mutants passed".
# The last two surfaces are the ones this register cannot reach: budget admission is the
# next calculus's, and nothing here observes a running system. Both carry a metric whose
# recorded value is the literal UNVERIFIED.
